action.command: cd /tmp && so=$(find x -name "*.so" | head -1); echo "$so"; ls -la x/usr/lib/postgresql/17/lib/; command -v objdump readelf ldd; readelf -V "$so" 2>&1 | grep -oE "GLIBCXX_[0-9.]+|GLIBC_[0-9.]+" | sort -uV | tail -6

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && so=$(find x -name \"*.so\" | head -1); echo \"$so\"; ls -la x/usr/lib/postgresql/17/lib/; command -v objdump readelf ldd; readelf -V \"$so\" 2>&1 | grep -oE \"GLIBCXX_[0-9.]+|GLIBC_[0-9.]+\" | sort -uV | tail -6", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Inspect pgrouting so symbols with readelf"}
